class.name: IfcRelDefinesByObject
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelDefinesByObject defines the relationship between an object taking part in an object type decomposition and an object occurrences taking part in an occurrence decomposition of that type. The IfcRelDefinesByObject is a 1-to-N relationship, as it allows for the assignment of one declaring object information to a single or to many reflected objects. Those objects the
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Objects being part of an object occurrence decomposition, acting as the "reflecting parts" in the relationship. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Object being part of an object type decomposition, acting as the "declaring part" in the relationship. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
